channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Starter homes cost $1 million in a record 242 U.S. cities—proof the affordability crisis has hit the homes meant for first-time buyers
item.description: The first rung on the property ladder now costs seven figures in a record 242 cities, a new Zillow report shows.

item.title: This CEO lived on canned soup and took just two days off for his daughter’s birth. Now, he admits he lost sight of proper work-life balance
item.description: Ron Schneidermann, CEO of test prep company Acely, is urging Gen Z to do it differently.

item.title: Billionaire Brian Chesky’s social-worker parents told him to pick a high-paying career. He went to art school—and started Airbnb with 3 air beds
item.description: Chesky’s mother, herself a social worker, was worried when he became an art student. He started Airbnb when he was barely making rent.

item.title: Berkshire Hathaway stock is a haven again as investors flee AI bloodbath while its own portfolio takes a hit amid reshuffling
item.description: Berkshire bought $2.4 billion of stocks during the third quarter and sold some $2.8 billion.
